an6.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an6.10:1.2: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.10:1.3: ”yo so bhante ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī”ti.
an6.10:2.1: yo so mahānāma ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharati: (1)
an6.10:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
an6.10:2.4: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.10:2.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.
an6.10:2.6: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an6.10:2.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:2.9: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati. sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati. dhammasotaṃ samāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti. (2)
an6.10:3.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati:
an6.10:3.2: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”tī.
an6.10:3.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.10:3.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha.
an6.10:3.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an6.10:3.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:3.8: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati. sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati. dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhammānussatiṃ bhāveti. (3)
an6.10:4.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati:
an6.10:4.2: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭhapurisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo, pāhuneyyo, dakkhiṇeyyo, añjalikaraṇīyo, anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
an6.10:4.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
an6.10:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbha.
an6.10:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an6.10:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:4.8: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno saṅghānussatiṃ bhāveti. (4)
an6.10:5.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati: akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an6.10:5.2: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.10:5.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.
an6.10:5.4: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an6.10:5.5: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:5.7: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti. (5)
an6.10:6.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati:
an6.10:6.3: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti.
an6.10:6.4: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.10:6.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha.
an6.10:6.6: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ,
an6.10:6.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:6.9: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti. (6)
an6.10:7.1: puna caparaṃ mahānāma ariyasāvako devatānussatiṃ bhāveti:
an6.10:7.2: “santi devā cātummahārājikā, santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā, santi devā tusitā, santi devā nimmānaratino, santi devā paranimmita vasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā taduttariṃ.
an6.10:7.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati,
an6.10:7.4: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati.
an6.10:7.5: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati.
an6.10:7.6: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati.
an6.10:7.7: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī”ti.
an6.10:7.8: yasmiṃ mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsaṃca devatānaṃ saddhaṃca sīlaṃ ca sutaṃ ca cāgaṃca paññaṃ ca anussarati, nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.10:7.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tā devatā ārabbha
an6.10:7.10: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ.
an6.10:7.11: pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
an6.10:7.13: ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati. dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an6.10:8.1: yo so mahānāma ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī’ti.
